193| def classify_error(rec: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
194|     """S2 classification: 'retryable' vs 'permanent' (never both-never-retried).
195| 
196|     retryable: HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, empty_content, timeouts/URLError.
197|     permanent: HTTP 400, HTTP 404 (window-death), and lane-config facts
198|     (SSRF_GUARD, NO_KEY, LITE_PACED) that no retry can fix.
199|     """
200|     err = str(rec.get("error") or "")
201|     if err == "empty_content":
202|         return "retryable"
203|     m = _re.match(r"HTTP (\d{3})$", err)
204|     if m:
205|         code = int(m.group(1))
206|         if code in (400, 404):
207|             return "permanent"
208|         return "retryable"  # 429/5xx/unclassified HTTP are budgeted
209|     if err in ("SSRF_GUARD", "NO_KEY", "LITE_PACED"):
210|         return "permanent"
211|     if any(k in err for k in ("Timeout", "URLError", "timed out", "ConnectionReset",
212|                               "RemoteDisconnected")):
213|         return "retryable"
214|     return "permanent"  # unknown shapes fail fast; the queue is durable

217| def jitter_sleep_seconds(attempt: int) -> float:
218|     """S1 full jitter: uniform(0, min(cap, base * 2**attempt)) before a retry."""
219|     import random

223| class RetryBudget:
224|     """S2 token bucket: RETRY_BUDGET_PER_MIN retries per minute per process.
225| 
226|     Successes deposit; retries withdraw; an empty bucket fails fast and
227|     leaves the item for the next run (the queue is durable: a deferred retry
228|     is not a lost dig). Continuous refill at per_minute/60 per second.
229|     """
230| 
231|     def __init__(self, per_minute: int = RETRY_BUDGET_PER_MIN) -> None:
232|         self.rate = per_minute / 60.0
233|         self.capacity = float(per_minute)
234|         self.tokens = float(per_minute)
235|         self.ts = time.time()
236| 
237|     def _refill(self) -> None:
238|         now = time.time()
239|         self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (now - self.ts) * self.rate)
240|         self.ts = now
241| 
242|     def deposit(self) -> None:
243|         self._refill()
244|         self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + 1.0)
245| 
246|     def try_withdraw(self) -> bool:
247|         self._refill()
248|         if self.tokens >= 1.0:
249|             self.tokens -= 1.0
250|             return True
251|         return False

254| class LaneBreaker:
255|     """S3 per-lane closed/open/half-open breaker.
256| 
257|     open after BREAKER_THRESHOLD consecutive failures of ANY class or a
258|     single HTTP 404 window-death; the spec's retryable-only wording is
259|     deliberately widened to any-failure because the raw.jsonl falsifier
260|     demands together-llama (6 consecutive HTTP 400, zero answers) stop
261|     routing after its 3rd consecutive failure. cooldown BREAKER_COOLDOWN_S,
262|     then half-open admitting at most HALF_OPEN_PROBES probes; any success
263|     closes, any failure reopens.
264|     """
265| 
266|     def __init__(self, threshold: int = BREAKER_THRESHOLD,
267|                  cooldown: float = BREAKER_COOLDOWN_S,
268|                  probes: int = HALF_OPEN_PROBES) -> None:
269|         self.threshold = threshold
270|         self.cooldown = cooldown
271|         self.max_probes = probes
272|         self.st: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
273| 
274|     def _st(self, lane: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
275|         return self.st.setdefault(lane, {"fails": 0, "state": "closed",
276|                                          "opened_at": 0.0, "probes": 0})
277| 
278|     def allow(self, lane: str) -> bool:
279|         s = self._st(lane)
280|         if s["state"] == "closed":
281|             return True
282|         if s["state"] == "open":
283|             if time.time() - s["opened_at"] >= self.cooldown:
284|                 s["state"] = "half_open"
285|                 s["probes"] = 0
286|             else:
287|                 return False
288|         if s["state"] == "half_open":
289|             if s["probes"] < self.max_probes:
290|                 s["probes"] += 1
291|                 return True
292|             return False
293|         return True
294| 
295|     def record(self, lane: str, ok: bool, error_class: str = "") -> None:
296|         s = self._st(lane)
297|         if ok:
298|             s.update({"fails": 0, "state": "closed", "probes": 0})
299|             return
300|         s["fails"] += 1
301|         if s["state"] == "half_open" or s["fails"] >= self.threshold:
302|             s["state"] = "open"
303|             s["opened_at"] = time.time()

89| def adb(*args: str, timeout: int = 60, binary_to: Path | None = None) -> str:

94|         return ""
95|     r = subprocess.run([ADB, *args], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)

101| def dump_tree() -> list[dict]:
102|     """uiautomator dump -> compact node list (the AX channel)."""
103|     adb("shell", "uiautomator", "dump", "/sdcard/ui_endow.xml")
104|     local = OUT / "ui_last.xml"
105|     adb("pull", "/sdcard/ui_endow.xml", str(local))
106|     root = ET.parse(local).getroot()
107|     nodes = []
108|     for n in root.iter("node"):
109|         txt = (n.get("text") or "").strip()
110|         desc = (n.get("content-desc") or "").strip()
111|         cls = (n.get("class") or "").split(".")[-1]
112|         clickable = (n.get("clickable") or "") == "true"
113|         bounds = n.get("bounds") or ""
114|         m = re.match(r"\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\]\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\]", bounds)
115|         if not (txt or desc or clickable):

117|         node = {"cls": cls, "text": txt, "desc": desc, "clickable": clickable,
118|                 "bounds": bounds}
119|         if m:
120|             l, t, r, b = map(int, m.groups())
121|             node["rect"] = [l, t, r, b]
122|             node["center"] = [(l + r) // 2, (t + b) // 2]
123|         nodes.append(node)

180| def parse_public_keys(body: str) -> tuple[PublicKeyLine, ...]:
181|     """STRICT parse of a .keys body: every non-blank line must be a known
182|     keytype + valid base64 blob whose embedded wire-type matches. No silent

58| def energy_curve(onset: list[float], bpm: float) -> list[int]:
59|     """Aggregate the 20ms onset envelope into per-8th-note-step energy 0..255."""
60|     frames_per_sec = 1000.0 / 20
61|     step_secs = 60.0 / bpm / 2
62|     frames_per_step = max(1, int(round(frames_per_sec * step_secs)))
63|     n_steps = min(ENERGY_STEPS, len(onset) // frames_per_step)
64|     curve: list[int] = []
65|     for s in range(n_steps):
66|         chunk = onset[s * frames_per_step:(s + 1) * frames_per_step]
67|         v = sum(chunk) / len(chunk) if chunk else 0.0
68|         curve.append(v)
69|     peak = max(curve) or 1.0
70|     return [min(255, int(c / peak * 255)) for c in curve]

96| def block_means(rows: list[list[int]], n: int = GRID) -> list[list[int]]:
97|     """64x64 block means via sum//count. Integer partition: block y covers
98|     source rows [y*H//n, (y+1)*H//n) — full coverage, no overlap, no
99|     floats, deterministic for any tile size >= n."""
100|     h = len(rows)
101|     if h < n:
102|         raise ValueError(f"tile edge {h} < block edge {n}")
103|     means = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
104|     for by in range(n):
105|         r0, r1 = by * h // n, (by + 1) * h // n
106|         for bx in range(n):
107|             c0, c1 = bx * h // n, (bx + 1) * h // n
108|             s = 0
109|             for r in range(r0, r1):
110|                 s += sum(rows[r][c0:c1])
111|             means[by][bx] = s // ((r1 - r0) * (c1 - c0))

121|     span = hi - lo

263| def parse_judge(text: str) -> dict:
264|     """Parse the strict judge contract. Returns winner/criteria/rationale/parsed.
265| 
266|     parsed is True only when a valid winner line AND a rationale line were
267|     found; a missing criterion table does not void the verdict but is
268|     reported by len(criteria). Unparseable output yields winner UNPARSED
269|     and parsed False so the caller can refuse to bank a fake verdict.
270|     """
271|     winner = "UNPARSED"
272|     criteria: list[dict] = []
273|     rationale = ""
274|     for raw in (text or "").splitlines():
275|         line = raw.strip()
276|         if not line:
277|             continue
278|         low = line.lower()
279|         if low.startswith("winner:") and winner == "UNPARSED":
280|             m = WINNER_RE.match(line)
281|             if m:
282|                 w = m.group("w").upper()
283|                 winner = "TIE" if w == "TIE" else w
284|         elif low.startswith("crit"):
285|             m = CRIT_RE.match(line)
286|             if m:
287|                 criteria.append({
288|                     "criterion": m.group("crit").strip(),
289|                     "a": int(m.group("a")),
290|                     "b": int(m.group("b")),
291|                     "note": m.group("note").strip(),

142| # ------------------------------------------------------------ float32 codec ----
143| 
144| def f32b(v: float) -> int:
145|     """float64 -> its float32 bit pattern as int (rounds to nearest)."""
146|     return struct.unpack("<I", struct.pack("<f", v))[0]
147| 
148| 
149| def b32f(bits: int) -> float:
150|     """float32 bit pattern -> float64 (exact widening)."""
151|     return struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<I", bits & 0xFFFFFFFF))[0]
152| 
153| 
154| def enc32(v: float) -> str:
155|     return f"0x{f32b(v):08x}"
156| 
157| 
158| def dec32(s: str) -> float:
159|     return b32f(int(s, 16))
160| 
161| 
162| def ulp32(x: float) -> float:
163|     """One float32 unit-in-the-last-place at |x| (the named epsilon unit)."""
164|     bits = f32b(abs(x))
165|     exp = (bits >> 23) & 0xFF
166|     if exp == 0xFF:
167|         return math.inf
168|     if exp == 0:
169|         return 2.0 ** -149                 # smallest subnormal
170|     return 2.0 ** (exp - 127 - 23)         # normal spacing
171| 
172| 
173| def band(R: float) -> float:
174|     """Threshold band half-width: 8*ulp32(R^2) (V2ASK3 Tier-D exception)."""
175|     return EDGE_BAND_ULPS * ulp32(R * R)

180| def parse_gc() -> dict[str, float]:
181|     """game_constants.gd's flock family, parsed (the Q15 single source)."""
182|     src = GC_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
183|     out: dict[str, float] = {}
184|     for name in CONST_NAMES:
185|         m = re.search(rf"^const {name} := ([0-9.eE+-]+)", src, re.M)
186|         if not m:
187|             raise ValueError(f"{name} missing from {GC_PATH}")
188|         out[name] = float(m.group(1))

192| def consts_hash(consts: dict[str, float] | None = None) -> str:
193|     """sha256 over 'NAME=<float32 bits hex>\\n' lines, name-sorted — the
194|     byte-identical text the GDScript runner hashes from its GC preload."""
195|     consts = consts if consts is not None else parse_gc()
196|     body = "".join(f"{n}={enc32(consts[n])}\n" for n in sorted(consts))
197|     return hashlib.sha256(body.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

208| def _rand_fish(rng: random.Random, n: int, cx: float, cy: float,
209|                spread: float) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
210|     """n fish jittered around (cx, cy), vel 0, fatigue/satiation 0, alive.
211|     Positions are kept >= 1.0 px apart: flock.gd's school loop compares
212|     Dictionary equality BY VALUE (`other == f`), so two full-state twins
213|     would be skipped in GDScript but counted in Python — twins are excluded
214|     by construction and the driver trips if one ever forms."""
215|     fish: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
216|     tries = 0
217|     while len(fish) < n and tries < n * 400:
218|         tries += 1
219|         pos = (cx + rng.uniform(-spread, spread), cy + rng.uniform(-spread, spread))
220|         if all(math.hypot(pos[0] - f["pos"][0], pos[1] - f["pos"][1]) > 1.0 for f in fish):
221|             fish.append({"id": len(fish), "pos": pos, "vel": (0.0, 0.0),
222|                          "fatigue": 0.0, "satiation": 0.0, "alive": True})
223|     if len(fish) < n:
224|         raise RuntimeError("could not place distinct fish (twin guard)")
225|     return fish

1| """Provider config, the in-process test double, and real endpoint calls.
2| 
3| One config file (JSON or YAML) declares every endpoint: local clones,
4| the mid tier, and the frontier. A provider entry looks like:
5| 
6|     {
7|       "model_id": "flash-mid-1",
8|       "base_url": "http://localhost:4000/v1",
9|       "model": "vendor/flash",
10|       "tier": "mid",
11|       "cost_usd_per_call": 0.004,
12|       "latency_ms": 800,
13|       "test_double": true,
14|       "confidence_default": 0.9,
15|       "confidence_by_task_shape": {"design_judgment": 0.55}
16|     }
17| 
18| Top-level keys: tier_order (cheapest to most expensive, e.g.
19| ["local", "mid", "frontier"]), exploration_model (the designated mid-tier
20| model for unknown task shapes), providers (list as above).
21| 
22| TEST-DOUBLE MODE: when "test_double" is true the provider is answered by
23| an in-process fake, indistinguishable from a real one at the router call
24| boundary. Answers are deterministic: derived from sha256 of the payload,
25| never RNG. Confidence is configurable per model and per task_shape.
26| Latency is DECLARED, not slept: the constraint filter uses the declared
27| estimate and the response reports it; tests stay fast and deterministic.
28| 
29| REAL MODE: OpenAI-compatible POST {base_url}/chat/completions via
30| stdlib urllib. Confidence convention: when the endpoint provides a
31| calibrated probability (our clones do), it is read from the response
32| field "confidence" at the top level or inside choices[0]; otherwise
33| confidence is null and rule (d) of the router does not apply.
34| """

123|     path = Path(path)

62| # Loopback-pinned HTTP transport (anti-SSRF by construction):

249|             "fooled_into_gain": (int(((pred == LABEL_TO_IDX[GAIN]) & m).sum())
250|                                  if scope == "twin" else 0),
251|             "coverage": n_ans / n if n else 0.0,
252|             "answered": n_ans, "answered_correct": n_corr,
253|             "answered_wrong": n_ans - n_corr,
254|             "soundness": (n_corr / n_ans) if n_ans else float("nan"),
255|         }
256| 
257|     out: dict[str, Any] = {"arm": name, "mode": mode, "n": int(len(y)),
258|                            "tau": tau, "by_family": {}}
259|     for scope, twin in (("all", None), ("orig", False), ("twin", True)):
260|         m = np.ones(len(y), dtype=bool) if twin is None else _slice(twin)
261|         out[scope] = _rows(m, scope)
262|     for fam in sorted(set(family.tolist())):
263|         mo, mt = _slice(False, fam), _slice(True, fam)
264|         out["by_family"][fam] = {
265|             "orig_forced_acc": float(correct[mo].mean()),
266|             "twin_forced_acc": float(correct[mt].mean()),
267|             **_pair_metrics(pred, correct, mo, mt),
268|         }
269|     out["pairs"] = _pair_metrics(pred, correct, ~is_twin, is_twin)
270|     if mode != "raw":
271|         out["tripwires"] = {k: lat[k] for k in ("answered_infeasible",
272|                                                 "answered_not_raw")}
273|     return out

276| def _pair_metrics(pred: np.ndarray, correct: np.ndarray, m_o: np.ndarray,
277|                   m_t: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
278|     """Both-correct / distinguished over pairs (m_o and m_t select the
279|     originals and twins in the same pair order)."""
280|     n = int(m_o.sum())
281|     if n == 0 or int(m_t.sum()) != n:
282|         return {"pairs": n, "both_correct": 0, "distinguished": 0}
283|     return {
284|         "pairs": n,
285|         "both_correct": int((correct[m_o] & correct[m_t]).sum()),
286|         "distinguished": int((pred[m_o] != pred[m_t]).sum()),
287|     }

291| def run_experiment(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:

293|     tau = args.threshold
294|     hidden = [int(h) for h in args.hidden.split(",")]

325|               f"{manifest['families']} -> {manifest['path']} "
326|               f"(sha256 {manifest['sha256'][:12]}…)")

332|     is_twin = np.array([i % 2 == 1 for i in range(len(rows))], dtype=bool)
333|     family = np.array([p["family"] for p in pairs for _ in range(2)])
334| 
335|     # truth-feasibility law on the adversarial set (must hold by construction)
336|     truth_out = sum(1 for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r["label"] not in feas[i])
337|     print(f"\ntrain={len(train_rows)} (frozen recipe seed={args.seed}) "

1| """legality_dataset — W3K: LDT legality dataset over the REAL water-graph engine.
2| 
3| Mickey17 W3 lane (2026-09-29). The N4 LDT experiment design
4| (logs/mates/night_burn_20260930.jsonl, row "N4-ldt-experiment") calls for a
5| legality corpus shaped `(state vector + action -> label)` rendered as a flat
6| token sequence. This tool builds that corpus locally, deterministically, $0:
7| 
8|   - States: seeded-random WaterGraph boards in the Mountain family
9|     (server/world.py build_mountain_graph): every board keeps `crown` the
10|     unique COLD node at the strict max elevation and `waste` at elev 0, so
11|     `crown` can only be fed by steam condensation — the Mountain's own law
12|     (the gate route can never reach the crown; the boil route can).
13|   - Actions: verbs from the world's live verb table (CHAT_TABLE.verbs via
14|     server/protocol_table.py: the DEFAULT v0 four plus say/whisper, same
15|     source as server/world.VERBS) plus fake verbs/targets so every reject
16|     reason (UNKNOWN_VERB / UNKNOWN_TARGET / DRY_POOL / BAD_TEXT) is
17|     represented. (Was server.protocol.VERBS, the 4-verb DEFAULT set, which
18|     mislabeled say/whisper as UNKNOWN_VERB in training data — caught by the
19|     Q11 mirror lane 2026-10-01.)
20|   - Labels: legality is MountainWorld.validate's exact rule set minus the
21|     sid check (no sessions in a dataset); the one-step outcome is measured,
22|     not modeled — the action is applied with MountainWorld._apply's physics
23|     (boil lifts 1, valve toggles, join/tag touch nothing) and one REAL
24|     WaterGraph.tick() runs; crown_gain := crown volume strictly rose.
25| 
26| Determinism law (single random.Random(seed) stream, canonical sorted-key
27| JSONL, no wall clock anywhere in the outputs): same seed -> byte-identical
28| train/val splits. Pinned by tests/test_legality_dataset.py, which also
29| spot-checks 10 samples against mag/water_graph.py directly (independent
30| re-derivation, not this module's own labeler).
31| 
32| Output: <out>/train.jsonl, <out>/val.jsonl, <out>/MANIFEST.json (seed,
33| counts, label distribution, per-file sha256).
34| """
35| from __future__ import annotations

38| import hashlib
39| import json

41| import sys

43| from typing import Any

56| # Board vocabulary (Mountain family). Fake pools deliberately sit OUTSIDE
57| # these namespaces so an UNKNOWN_TARGET sample can never collide with a
58| # real name.
59| _NODE_POOL = ["terrace", "hollow", "gate1", "gate2", "sill1", "pool",
60|               "ridge", "benches", "flats"]
61| _PIPE_POOL = ["p_spring", "p_terrace", "p_out", "p_drain", "p_bypass",
62|               "p_ridge", "p_flats", "p_pool"]
63| _FAKE_NODES = ["ghost", "moon", "vent", "sump"]
64| _FAKE_VERBS = ["purify", "dig", "freeze", "douse"]
65| _KIND_WEIGHTS = [("plain", 0.6), ("xor", 0.2), ("sill", 0.2)]
66| 
67| 
68| # --------------------------------------------------------------- boards ----
69| def make_graph_spec(rng: random.Random) -> dict[str, Any]:
70|     """One seeded-random Mountain-family board (water_graph.v1 spec shape,
71|     plus node `sill`/`steam` and pipe `primed` so from_spec + restore is
72|     lossless)."""
73|     n_extra = rng.randint(1, 9)                       # |V| in [4, 12]
74|     names = rng.sample(_NODE_POOL, n_extra)
75| 
76|     nodes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
77|     nodes["spring"] = {"elev": rng.randint(8, 11), "kind": "plain",
78|                        "sill": 0, "volume": rng.randint(0, 6), "steam": 0}
79|     for name in names:
80|         r = rng.random()
81|         # weighted kind pick, cumulative thresholds (plain 0.6 / xor 0.2 / sill 0.2)
82|         kind = "plain" if r < _KIND_WEIGHTS[0][1] else (
83|             "xor" if r < _KIND_WEIGHTS[0][1] + _KIND_WEIGHTS[1][1] else "sill")
84|         nodes[name] = {
85|             "elev": rng.randint(1, 7),
86|             "kind": kind,
87|             "sill": rng.randint(1, 3) if kind == "sill" else 0,
88|             "volume": rng.randint(0, 3),
89|             "steam": 0,
90|         }
91|     nodes["waste"] = {"elev": 0, "kind": "waste", "sill": 0,
92|                       "volume": 0, "steam": 0}
93|     # crown: unique COLD node, strictly highest — the Mountain law.
94|     nodes["crown"] = {"elev": 15, "kind": "cold", "sill": 0,
95|                       "volume": rng.randint(0, 2), "steam": 0}
96| 
97|     # occasional pre-existing steam: the condensation route already armed
98|     steamables = [n for n in nodes if n not in ("crown",)]
99|     if steamables and rng.random() < 0.15:
100|         nodes[rng.choice(steamables)]["steam"] = rng.randint(1, 2)
101| 
102|     node_names = list(nodes)
103|     pipes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
104|     n_pipes = max(3, round(1.5 * len(node_names)) + rng.randint(-1, 1))
105|     pipe_names = [p for p in _PIPE_POOL if p not in pipes][:n_pipes] or []
106|     seen_pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
107|     pipe_idx = 0
108|     while len(pipes) < n_pipes and pipe_idx < 200:
109|         src, dst = rng.sample(node_names, 2)
110|         if (src, dst) in seen_pairs:
111|             continue
112|         seen_pairs.add((src, dst))
113|         name = (pipe_names[pipe_idx] if pipe_idx < len(pipe_names)
114|                 else f"p{pipe_idx}")
115|         siphon = rng.random() < 0.2
116|         pipes[name] = {
117|             "src": src, "dst": dst, "cap": rng.randint(1, 2),
118|             "siphon": siphon, "crest": rng.randint(2, 3) if siphon else 2,
119|             "primed": False, "open": rng.random() < 0.8,
120|         }
121|         pipe_idx += 1
122| 
123|     return {"schema": "water_graph.v1", "tick": 0,
124|             "nodes": nodes, "pipes": pipes}

127| def rebuild_graph(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> WaterGraph:
128|     """from_spec + restore the two fields from_spec drops (node.steam,
129|     pipe.primed) so a sample's board is byte-faithful to its spec."""
130|     g = from_spec(spec)
131|     for name, nd in spec["nodes"].items():
132|         g.nodes[name].steam = int(nd.get("steam", 0))
133|     for name, pp in spec["pipes"].items():
134|         g.pipes[name].primed = bool(pp.get("primed", False))
135|     return g

138| # --------------------------------------------------------------- labels ----
139| def engine_validate(g: WaterGraph, verb: str, target: str) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
140|     """MountainWorld.validate (server/world.py) verbatim minus the sid
141|     check: a dataset has no sessions, so UNKNOWN_SID cannot occur."""
142|     if verb not in VERBS:
143|         return False, "UNKNOWN_VERB"
144|     if verb == "valve":
145|         if target not in g.pipes:
146|             return False, "UNKNOWN_TARGET"
147|         return True, None
148|     if target not in g.nodes:
149|         return False, "UNKNOWN_TARGET"
150|     if verb in ("boil", "tag") and g.nodes[target].volume <= 0:
151|         return False, "DRY_POOL"
152|     return True, None
153|

155| def engine_apply(g: WaterGraph, verb: str, target: str) -> None:
156|     """MountainWorld._apply's physics (boil lifts 1; valve toggles; join and
157|     tag are social verbs, no hydraulics)."""
158|     if verb == "boil":
159|         g.boil(target, 1)
160|     elif verb == "valve":
161|         pipe = g.pipes[target]
162|         if pipe.open:
163|             g.close(target)
164|         else:
165|             g.open(target)

168| def label_sample(spec: dict[str, Any], verb: str, target: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
169|     """Legality + one-step outcome, both measured on the real engine."""
170|     g = rebuild_graph(spec)
171|     ok, why = engine_validate(g, verb, target)
172|     reason = {"UNKNOWN_VERB": "unknown_verb",
173|               "UNKNOWN_TARGET": "unknown_target",
174|               "DRY_POOL": "dry_pool"}.get(why or "")
175|     crown_gain = False
176|     if ok:
177|         crown_before = g.volume("crown")
178|         engine_apply(g, verb, target)
179|         g.tick()
180|         crown_gain = g.volume("crown") > crown_before
181|     label = (f"illegal_{reason}" if reason
182|              else ("legal_gain" if crown_gain else "legal_no_gain"))
183|     return {"legal": ok, "illegal_reason": reason,
184|             "crown_gain": crown_gain, "label": label}

187| # -------------------------------------------------------------- actions ----
188| def sample_action(rng: random.Random, spec: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
189|     """Coverage-shaped action draw: mostly honest tries, plus guaranteed
190|     streams of each reject reason (dry-pool hunters, fake verbs, fake
191|     targets)."""
192|     node_names = list(spec["nodes"])
193|     pipe_names = list(spec["pipes"])
194|     roll = rng.random()
195|     if roll < 0.10:                                   # unknown verb
196|         return rng.choice(_FAKE_VERBS), rng.choice(node_names + pipe_names)
197|     if roll < 0.20:                                   # unknown target
198|         verb = rng.choice(VERBS)
199|         fake = (_FAKE_NODES if verb != "valve" else
200|                 [f"p_{n}" for n in _FAKE_NODES])
201|         return verb, rng.choice(fake)
202|     if roll < 0.40:                                   # dry-pool hunter
203|         verb = rng.choice(("boil", "tag"))
204|         dry = [n for n in node_names if spec["nodes"][n]["volume"] <= 0]
205|         target = rng.choice(dry) if dry else rng.choice(node_names)
206|         return verb, target
207|     verb = rng.choice(VERBS)                          # honest try
208|     if verb == "valve":
209|         target = (rng.choice(pipe_names) if pipe_names and rng.random() < 0.8
210|                   else rng.choice([f"p_{n}" for n in _FAKE_NODES]))
211|     else:
212|         target = rng.choice(node_names) if rng.random() < 0.75 else rng.choice(_FAKE_NODES)
213|     return verb, target

216| # --------------------------------------------------------------- render ----
217| def render_tokens(spec: dict[str, Any], verb: str, target: str,
218|                   label: str) -> list[str]:
219|     """The N4 paper's flat shape: [node tokens; edge tokens; ACTION; LABEL].
220|     Every field is a typed token so a tiny transformer can consume it
221|     verbatim (atom vocabulary per the lattice design)."""
222|     toks = ["[STATE]"]
223|     for name, nd in spec["nodes"].items():
224|         toks += [f"n:{name}", f"k:{nd['kind']}", f"z:{nd['elev']}",
225|                  f"v:{nd['volume']}", f"s:{nd.get('steam', 0)}"]
226|         if nd["kind"] == "sill":
227|             toks.append(f"sill:{nd.get('sill', 0)}")
228|     for name, pp in spec["pipes"].items():
229|         toks += [f"p:{name}", f"{pp['src']}>{pp['dst']}", f"c:{pp['cap']}",
230|                  f"sip:{int(pp['siphon'])}", f"o:{int(pp['open'])}"]
231|         if pp["siphon"]:
232|             toks += [f"cr:{pp['crest']}", f"pr:{int(pp.get('primed', False))}"]
233|     toks += ["[ACTION]", f"verb:{verb}", f"tgt:{target}", "[LABEL]", label]
234|     return toks

237| # ------------------------------------------------------------ generation ----
238| def generate(n: int, seed: int, val_frac: float = 0.1) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]:
239|     rng = random.Random(seed)
240|     rows: list[dict] = []
241|     for i in range(n):
242|         spec = make_graph_spec(rng)
243|         verb, target = sample_action(rng, spec)
244|         lab = label_sample(spec, verb, target)
245|         rows.append({
246|             "id": f"ldt-{i:06d}",
247|             "schema": SCHEMA,
248|             "graph": spec,
249|             "verb": verb,
250|             "target": target,
251|             **lab,
252|             "tokens": render_tokens(spec, verb, target, lab["label"]),
253|         })
254|     # seeded shuffle (random.seed(str) is hash-free: sha512 of the bytes,
255|     # stable across runs and PYTHONHASHSEED values)
256|     order = list(range(n))
257|     random.Random(f"{seed}:split").shuffle(order)
258|     n_val = round(n * val_frac)
259|     val_ids = set(order[:n_val])
260|     train = [r for i, r in enumerate(rows) if i not in val_ids]
261|     val = [r for i, r in enumerate(rows) if i in val_ids]
262|     return train, val
263|

265| def _dump(rows: list[dict], path: Path) -> str:
266|     with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
267|         for r in rows:
268|             fh.write(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
269|     return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

272| def write_dataset(out_dir: Path, n: int, seed: int, val_frac: float = 0.1) -> dict:
273|     out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
274|     train, val = generate(n, seed, val_frac)
275|     manifest: dict[str, Any] = {
276|         "schema": SCHEMA,

278|         "verbs": list(VERBS),
279|         "label_field": "label",
280|         "label_set": ["illegal_unknown_verb", "illegal_unknown_target",
281|                       "illegal_dry_pool", "legal_no_gain", "legal_gain"],
282|     }
283|     files = {}
284|     for split, rows in (("train", train), ("val", val)):
285|         path = out_dir / f"{split}.jsonl"
286|         sha = _dump(rows, path)

109|     if p.scheme != "https":
110|         raise RuntimeError(f"endpoint fence: base_url must be https, got {base_url!r}")
111|     if p.query or p.fragment or p.username:
112|         raise RuntimeError("endpoint fence: base_url must be bare https host"
113|                            f"[/prefix] with no query/userinfo, got {base_url!r}")
114|     host = p.hostname or ""
115|     _family_of(host)
116|     path = p.path.rstrip("/")
117|     if not path:
118|         path = "/v1/chat/completions"
119|     elif not path.endswith("/chat/completions"):
120|         path += "/chat/completions"
121|     return urllib.parse.urlunsplit((p.scheme, p.netloc, path, "", "")), host

124| def _assert_public_host(host: str) -> None:
125|     for info in socket.getaddrinfo(host, 443, proto=socket.IPPROTO_TCP):
126|         ip = ipaddress.ip_address(info[4][0])
127|         if (ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback or ip.is_link_local
128|                 or ip.is_reserved or ip.is_multicast):
129|             raise RuntimeError(f"endpoint fence: {host} resolves to non-public {ip}")

132| def _api_key(base_env: str) -> str:
133|     """base_env names the env var: os.environ first, then ROOT/.env."""
134|     val = os.environ.get(base_env, "").strip()
135|     if val:
136|         return val
137|     env_file = ROOT / ".env"
138|     if env_file.is_file():
139|         for line in open(env_file, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
140|             if line.strip().startswith(base_env + "="):
141|                 val = line.strip().split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"').strip("'")
142|                 if val:
143|                     return val
144|     raise RuntimeError(f"no {base_env} in os.environ or {env_file}")

147| def _call(model: str, messages: list[dict], max_tokens: int | None, key: str,
148|           base_url: str, retries: int = 1,
149|           extra_body: dict | None = None) -> dict:
150|     # fence asserted PER CALL: the URL is rebuilt from the ask bytes every
151|     # time, so a stale patched constant cannot bypass the table
152|     url, host = _endpoint(base_url)
153|     _assert_public_host(host)
154|     # max_tokens None = UNCAPPED fire; extra_body = per-animal sampling rails
155|     # merged into the request body (e.g. z.ai reasoning_effort). Both are
156|     # API params only: the MESSAGE bytes stay byte-identical across families
157|     # (BATTERY.md law 1). Receipts: max_tokens-null = glm-5.3-flash row 17
158|     # (memory/continuity/seat_memory_20260927/ox-alpha-was-glm53-flash.md);
159|     # extra_body = z.ai 5.3-flash thinking-always-on law (thinking cannot be
160|     # disabled, 1210; bounded via reasoning_effort low + max_tokens >= the
161|     # 1536 floor per docs/ref/ZAI_API_EXPERT_REFERENCE.md section 4 + 5.1,
162|     # applied in the cheapgrid1 run after uncapped fires hung past the 900s
163|     # whole-response fence at default effort max / default budget 65536).
164|     body: dict = {"model": model, "messages": messages}
165|     if max_tokens is not None:
166|         body["max_tokens"] = max_tokens
167|     if extra_body:
168|         body.update(extra_body)
169|     body = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
170|     last = None
171|     for attempt in range(retries + 1):
172|         req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST",
173|                                      headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key,
174|                                               "Content-Type": "application/json"})
175|         try:
176|             with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=900) as r:
177|                 return json.loads(r.read())
178|         except (urllib.error.URLError, urllib.error.HTTPError, TimeoutError,
179|                 json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
180|             last = exc
181|             if attempt < retries:
182|                 time.sleep(20)
183|     raise RuntimeError(f"transport failed after {retries + 1} tries: {last!r}")
184|

186| def _read_evidence(paths: list[str]) -> str:
187|     parts = []
188|     for rel in paths:
189|         p = ROOT / rel
190|         if not p.is_file():
191|             parts.append(f"\n\n=== EVIDENCE {rel} (MISSING) ===\n")
192|             continue
193|         text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
194|         cap = 400_000
195|         if len(text) > cap:
196|             text = text[:cap] + f"\n... [truncated at {cap} chars]"
197|         parts.append(f"\n\n=== EVIDENCE {rel} ===\n{text}")
198|     return "".join(parts)

203|     with open(USAGE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
204|         fh.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

207| def _refusal_state(ask_id: str, family: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
208|     """(count, last snippet) of refusal ledger rows for one (id, family);
209|     refusals are data, not failures to retry."""
210|     count, snippet = 0, ""
211|     if USAGE.exists():
212|         for line in open(USAGE, encoding="utf-8"):
213|             try:
214|                 row = json.loads(line)
215|             except json.JSONDecodeError:
216|                 continue
217|             if (row.get("id") == ask_id and row.get("model_family") == family
218|                     and row.get("refused")):
219|                 count += 1
220|                 snippet = str(row["refused"])
221|     return count, snippet

228|                       "skips this ask on sight. Re-arm only by editing the ask bytes "

233| def _landed_skip(meta: dict, ask_dir: Path, out_path: Path) -> dict | None:
234|     """The deliverable-exists truth beats the force flag; only a pending
235|     revision riding turn2_only re-opens a landed ask."""
236|     if not out_path.exists():
237|         return None
238|     if (bool(meta.get("revision")) and (ask_dir / "revision.md").is_file()
239|             and meta.get("turn2_only")):
240|         return None
241|     return {"id": meta["id"], "ok": True,
242|             "skipped": ("output exists (no revision pending; force cannot "
243|                         "re-burn a landed deliverable)")}

246| def _assert_evidence_in_body(meta: dict, messages: list[dict]) -> None:
247|     """Fail closed BEFORE any API call on lost material."""
248|     evidence = meta.get("evidence") or []
249|     # self_contained is the guard's own "render it into the contract" path,
250|     # made explicit per ask (BATTERY.md amendment 2026-10-01): the garden-v1
251|     # battery stages B6/B8 evidence-less per its evidence table and the bare
252|     # fail-close rejected them; every ask without evidence[] AND without
253|     # self_contained still fails closed exactly as before (DUEL2 law).
254|     if not evidence and not meta.get("self_contained"):
255|         raise RuntimeError("EVIDENCE-PREFLIGHT: ask carries no evidence paths "
256|                            "(evidence: []) and no self_contained flag; refusing "
257|                            "an evidence-less fire. Stage the material into "
258|                            "evidence[] or render it into the contract and "
259|                            "declare self_contained: true")
260|     body = "\n".join(str(m.get("content") or "") for m in messages)
261|     for rel in evidence:
262|         p = ROOT / rel
263|         if not p.is_file():
264|             raise RuntimeError(f"EVIDENCE-PREFLIGHT: evidence path missing on disk: {rel}")
265|         probe = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[:400].strip()
266|         if not probe:
267|             raise RuntimeError(f"EVIDENCE-PREFLIGHT: evidence file is empty: {rel}")
268|         if probe not in body:
269|             raise RuntimeError(f"EVIDENCE-PREFLIGHT: rendered bytes of {rel} absent "
270|                                "from the message body (the render step dropped "
271|                                "the material)")

274| def run_ask(ask_dir: Path, key: str | None = None, execute: bool = True) -> dict:
275|     meta = json.loads((ask_dir / "ask.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
276|     for field in ("id", "model", "base_env", "base_url", "contract"):
277|         if not meta.get(field):
278|             raise ValueError(f"ask.json missing required field {field!r}")
279|     base_url, model = meta["base_url"], meta["model"]
280|     family = _family_of(_endpoint(base_url)[1])  # fence at entry
281|     if execute and key is None:
282|         # key resolved per ask: a missing base_env fails that ask loud
283|         key = _api_key(meta["base_env"])
284|     out_path = OUT_DIR / f"{meta['id']}.md"
285|     refused_marker = ask_dir / "REFUSED"
286|     if refused_marker.is_file():
287|         return {"id": meta["id"], "ok": True,
288|                 "skipped": "REFUSED (terminal; operator edit + marker removal "
289|                            "required to re-arm)"}
290|     refusals, refusal_snippet = _refusal_state(meta["id"], family)
291|     if refusals >= 2:
292|         _mint_refused_marker(ask_dir, meta["id"], refusal_snippet)
293|         return {"id": meta["id"], "ok": True,
294|                 "skipped": f"REFUSED (terminal; {refusals} ledger refusals, "
295|                            "marker minted)"}
296|     # INFERENCE-BUDGET entry: a terminally burned ask (EMPTY_REASONING
297|     # marker) never refires the same params (the one-bug law, 2026-10-01).
298|     done = skip_terminal(ask_dir, meta["id"])
299|     if done is not None:
300|         return done
301|     skip = _landed_skip(meta, ask_dir, out_path)
302|     if skip is not None:
303|         return skip
304|     # the carrier's _system_for is model-agnostic (claritas face + the fixed
305|     # estate-law block): single-sourced from hermes_burn, not forked.
306|     # X3-1 A/B knob (BATTERY.md amendment X3-1): system "bare" fires the ask
307|     # with NO system prefix so the face's per-family value is measurable;
308|     # any other value fails loud here (fail-closed: no silent arm drift).
309|     system_mode = meta.get("system")
310|     if system_mode not in (None, "", "bare"):
311|         raise ValueError('ask.json "system" must be "bare" or absent, got '
312|                          f"{system_mode!r}")
313|     from tools.hermes_burn import _system_for
314|     body = ("=== CONTRACT ===\n" + meta["contract"]
315|             + "\n\n=== EVIDENCE ===" + _read_evidence(meta.get("evidence", []))
316|             + "\n\nProduce the deliverable the CONTRACT demands. Positive AND "
317|             "negative examples where they clarify. Match the requested shape "
318|             "exactly.")
319|     if system_mode == "bare":
320|         prompt = body
321|     else:
322|         prompt = _system_for(model) + "\n\n" + body
323|     messages = [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
324|     original_user_msg = messages[0]
325|     turns = []
326|     result_row = {"id": meta["id"], "model": model, "model_family": family,
327|                   "ok": True}
328|     for turn_no in (1, 2):
329|         if turn_no == 2:
330|             rev = ask_dir / "revision.md"
331|             if not meta.get("revision") or not rev.is_file() or not execute:
332|                 break
333|             # revision turns carry ONLY [original prompt, revision message]:
334|             # the model re-derives its own draft, no echo
335|             messages = [original_user_msg,
336|                         {"role": "user", "content": rev.read_text(encoding="utf-8")}]
337|         if turn_no == 1 and meta.get("turn2_only"):
338|             turns.append({"turn": 1, "skipped": "turn2_only"})
339|             continue
340|         # preflight runs in dry mode too: offline, and the point of --dry
341|         _assert_evidence_in_body(meta, messages)
342|         if not execute:
343|             turns.append({"turn": turn_no, "dry": True})
344|             continue
345|         # INFERENCE-BUDGET: the RIB_MODEL_GATES recipe plans the fire (floor
346|         # per ask shape, thinking control, forbiddens stripped from the ask's
347|         # body_extra) and guards the response (fable B1/B5 shape terminal).
348|         plan = plan_call(model=model, family=family, prompt_chars=len(prompt),
349|                          requested_max_tokens=meta.get("max_tokens"),
350|                          ask_extra=meta.get("body_extra"))
351|         if plan.extra_body:
352|             resp = _call(model, messages, plan.max_tokens, key, base_url,
353|                          extra_body=plan.extra_body)
354|         else:
355|             resp = _call(model, messages, plan.max_tokens, key, base_url)
356|         usage = resp.get("usage", {})
357|         pin, pout = usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0), usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)
358|         cin, cout = PRICING.get(model, (0.0, 0.0))
359|         cost = pin * cin + pout * cout
360|         msg = resp["choices"][0]["message"]
361|         finish_reason = resp["choices"][0].get("finish_reason")
362|         raw_content = msg.get("content")
363|         if cause := guard_terminal(ask_dir, meta["id"], plan.recipe_key, finish_reason, usage, raw_content, _bank, model=model, family=family, base_url=base_url, pin=pin, pout=pout, cost=cost):
364|             raise RuntimeError("EMPTY_REASONING (terminal): " + cause
365|                                + ". Re-stage with the FAMILY_TABLE recipe or switch family")
366|         content, chan = raw_content, "content"
367|         if not content:
368|             # reasoning_content joins the fallback chain 2026-10-01: z.ai and
369|             # deepseek return the reasoning channel under reasoning_content
370|             # (probe receipts in the cheap-grid run), so reading only
371|             # "reasoning" dropped real provider bytes and raised empty-response
372|             # on fires the provider had actually answered.
373|             content, chan = msg.get("reasoning") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "", "reasoning (content channel empty)"
374|         if not content:
375|             refusal = msg.get("refusal")
376|             if refusal:
377|                 _bank({"ts": _now(), "id": meta["id"], "model": model,
378|                        "model_family": family, "base_url": base_url,
379|                        "turn": turn_no, "refused": refusal[:200],
380|                        "prompt_tokens": pin, "completion_tokens": pout,
381|                        "cost_usd": round(cost, 4), "ok": False})
382|                 n_refused, last_snippet = _refusal_state(meta["id"], family)
383|                 if n_refused >= 2 and not refused_marker.is_file():
384|                     _mint_refused_marker(ask_dir, meta["id"], last_snippet)
385|                 raise RuntimeError(f"REFUSED by provider: {refusal[:120]}")
386|             raise RuntimeError("empty response: both content and reasoning "
387|                                f"channels empty; usage={usage}")
388|         messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": content})
389|         row = {"ts": _now(), "id": meta["id"], "model": model,
390|                "model_family": family, "base_url": base_url, "turn": turn_no,
391|                "prompt_tokens": pin, "completion_tokens": pout,
392|                "reasoning_tokens": usage.get("completion_tokens_details", {}).get("reasoning_tokens"),
393|                "channel": chan, "cost_usd": round(cost, 4), "ok": True}
394|         _bank(row)
395|         turns.append(row)
396|         if turn_no == 1:
397|             OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
398|             out_path.write_text(
399|                 f"# {meta['id']} ({model} @ {family}, turn 1, channel: {chan})\n\n{content}\n",
400|                 encoding="utf-8")
401|         else:
402|             with open(out_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
403|                 fh.write(f"\n\n---\n\n# REVISION (turn 2)\n\n{content}\n")
404|     result_row["turns"] = turns
405|     result_row["cost_usd"] = round(sum(t.get("cost_usd", 0) for t in turns), 4)
406|     return result_row

409| def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
410|     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="model_garden")
411|     ap.add_argument("queue", help="dir of ask dirs (each holding ask.json)")
412|     ap.add_argument("--dry", action="store_true", help="validate asks offline, no calls")
413|     args = ap.parse_args(argv)
414|     qroot = Path(args.queue)
415|     if not qroot.is_dir():
416|         print(f"USAGE-ERROR: queue dir not found: {qroot}")
417|         return 2
418|     ask_dirs = sorted(p for p in qroot.iterdir() if (p / "ask.json").is_file())
419|     if not ask_dirs:
420|         print(f"USAGE-ERROR: no ask dirs under {qroot}")
421|         return 2
422|     failed = 0
423|     for d in ask_dirs:
424|         try:
425|             row = run_ask(d, execute=not args.dry)
426|             cost = row.get("cost_usd", 0)
427|             print(f"{'OK ' if row.get('ok') else 'FAIL'} {row['id']} "
428|                   f"[{row.get('model_family', '?')}] cost=${cost:.2f}"
429|                   + (" (skipped)" if row.get("skipped") else ""))
430|         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 fail-loud per ask, continue
431|             failed += 1
432|             print(f"FAIL {d.name}: {exc!r}")
433|     total = 0.0
434|     if USAGE.exists():
435|         for line in open(USAGE, encoding="utf-8"):
436|             try:
437|                 total += json.loads(line).get("cost_usd", 0)
438|             except json.JSONDecodeError:
439|                 total += 0.0  # torn tail write: counted as zero, not silent
440|     print(f"MODEL-GARDEN: {'FAIL' if failed else 'PASS'} "
441|           f"{len(ask_dirs) - failed}/{len(ask_dirs)} asks; ledger total ${total:.2f}")
442|     return 1 if failed else 0
